questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered 1 and 2. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No red is black.

All blues are black.

No blue is pink.

**Conclusions:**

1. No blue is red.

2. No red is pink.
questions.solution:
Statements:

No red is black.

All blues are black.

questions.question:
Which of the following interchange of numbers(not digits) would make the given equation correct?

15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

(1) 5, 15

⇒ 15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**5 ÷ 15**__ × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**0.33 × 12**__ + 6 = 65 - 35

⇒ 4 + 6 = 30

⇒ 10 = 30

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) 6, 12

⇒ 15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**15 ÷ 5 **__× 6 + 12 = 65 − 35

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**3 × 6**__ + 12 = 65 - 35

⇒ 18 + 12 = 30

⇒ 30 = 30

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) 5, 35

⇒ 15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**15 ÷ 35 **__× 12 + 6 = 65 − 5

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**0.4285 × 12 **__+ 6 = 60

⇒ 5.142 + 6 = 60

⇒ 11.142 = 60

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) 12, 65

⇒ 15 ÷ 5 × 12 + 6 = 65 − 35

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**15 ÷ 5**__ × 12 + 6 = 12 − 35

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 3 × 12 + 6 = (-23)

⇒ 36 + 6 = (-23)

⇒ 42 = (-23)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

questions.question: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, (MGNREGA) Government of India, comes under the flagship of ________.

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Rural Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act,** 2005** is the flagship scheme of the government of India under the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• It is claimed to be the world's largest employment scheme in terms of the number of people employed having around 12.84 crores workers.
 
• This act provides 100 days of wage employment per household in a financial year and as a matter of right, the applicant will get the work within 15 days of application otherwise compensation for it.
 
• The scheme was introduced in** 2006-07** in 200 districts and now spread across 648 districts of India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1991, the P.V Narashima Rao government proposed a pilot scheme for generating employment in rural areas with the following goals:

 
 
• Employment Generation for agricultural labour during the lean season
 
• Infrastructure Development
 
• Enhanced Food Security
 
 
 
• This scheme was called the Employment Assurance Scheme which later evolved into the MGNREGA after the merger with the Food for Work Programme in the early 2000s.
 
• The government has increased the per day wage rate from Rs 182.1 in 2019-20 to Rs 202.5 in 2020-21.
 
• Ministry of Rural Development (MRD), Government of India in association with state governments, monitors the implementation of the scheme.

questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for right to education?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**21A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act**, 2009 and enforced it as a fundamental right under Article 21-A.
 
• The 86th amendment to the constitution of India in 2002, provided the Right to Education as a fundamental right in part III of the Constitution.
 
• The same amendment inserted Article 21A which made the Right to Education a fundamental right for children between 6-14 years.
 
• The 86th amendment provided for follow-up legislation for the Right to Education Bill 2008 and finally the Right to Education Act 2009.
 
• Originally Part IV of the Indian Constitution, Article 45 and Article 39 (f) of DPSP, had a provision for state-funded as well as equitable and accessible education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Article
 Explanation
 
 
 
 

 Article 20
 This article declares that provides safeguards to ensure fairness and justice in criminal law, protecting individuals from retrospective punishment, double trials, and self-incrimination.
 
 

 Article 22
 This article establishes that every individual, as a member of society, is entitled to social security and has the right to the realization of economic, social, and cultural rights essential for his/her dignity and the free development of his/her personality.
 
 

 Article 23
 This article states that everyone has the right to work, to free choice of employment, to just and favorable conditions of work, and to protection against unemployment. Everyone should receive equal pay for equal work, and everyone who works has the right to just and favorable remuneration. It also endorses the right to form and join trade unions.

questions.question: Which dynasty ruled over Delhi during 1290 to 1320?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Khalji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khalji** 

 
 
• Khalji Dynasty- was the second ruling family of the Delhi sultanate, a Muslim kingdom in north India.
 
• The Khalji dynasty ruled from 1290 to 1320.
 
• It was founded by Jalal ud din Firuz Khalji and came to power in a revolution that signified the transfer of authority from Turkic nobility to Afghans.
 
• Alauddin Khalji made serious efforts to re-assess the land revenue and unify the taxes not only in rural areas but also in urban areas.
 
• He established a centralized administrative system of revenue collection. 
 
• Muqtis were appointed for revenue collection.
 
• Alauddin made sure that their offices were not hereditary.
 
• He kept proper control over them.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tughlaq dynasty 

 
 
• This was the Muslim dynasty of Indo-Turkic origin, ruled in India from 1320 AD - 1414 AD.
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty was founded by Ghiyas-ud-din Tughlaq.
 
• He ascended to the throne by killing Mubarak Khilji, the last ruler of the Khilji dynasty.
 
• Nasir-ud-din Muhammad Tughlaq was the last ruler of this dynasty.
 
 

 
• Lodi dynasty

 
 
• It was the fifth and last dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate. 
 
• The Lodi dynasty ruled from 1451 AD - 1526 AD.
 
• The founder of the Lodi dynasty was Bahlul Lodhi.
 
• This was an Afghan dynasty and was also known as the Pashtun dynasty.
 
• Ibrahim Lodhi was the last ruler of this dynasty and was killed by the Babur's troops in the battle of Panipat.
 
 

 
• Sayyid dynasty

 
 
• The Sayyid dynasty ruled over India after the invasion of Timur.
 
• Taimur invaded India during the reign of Nasir-ud-din Mahmud Shah Tughlaq of the Tughlaq dynasty in 1398 AD.
 
• The Sayyid dynasty was founded by Khizir Khan, who was the governor of Multan and Timur's deputy in India.
 
• Ala-ud-din Shah was the last ruler of this dynasty.

questions.question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellow (Akademi Ratna) has been awarded to ________.

• Jatin Goswami

 
 
• A well-known veteran classical dancer from Assam is Jatin Goswami.
 
• In 1933, Jatin Goswami was born in Dergaon, Upper Assam.
 
• Jatin Goswami began his first lesson of Satriya dance at home with the help of his father.
 
• Later, he received expert gurus' instruction in dance and music on the Vaishnava Satras.
 
• In order to advance and expand the Satriya dancing style, he also founded a dance group.

• During the Khajuraho Dance Festival, Jatin Goswami was given the National Kalidas Samman, Madhya Pradesh's most prestigious cultural award, for 2017.

• Sangeet Natak Akademi, the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country, was formed in 1953.
 
• It was set up for the preservation and promotion of the vast intangible heritage of India's diverse culture expressed in forms of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The management of the Akademi vests in its General Council.
 
• Ariyakudi Ramanuja Iyengar Karaikudi was the first to receive the Sahitya Natak Akademi award.

• The Akademi was officially inaugurated on 28 January 1953 by the first President of India Rajendra Prasad and PV Rajmannar was appointed as its first Chairman.

If two numbers are co-prime, their HCF is always 1. For such numbers, their LCM is simply the direct product of the two numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators). LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

questions.question: Two trains, starting at the same time from two stations 100 km apart are travelling towards each other and they cross each other at a distance of 70 km from one of the stations. What is the ratio of their speeds?

Distance between stations = 100 km

**Therefore, the ratio of their speeds is 7:3.**

questions.question: A is twice as efficient as B and takes 45 days less than B to complete a job. Find the number of days in which they can finish the job together.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's efficiency = 2B's efficiency

B's time - A's time = 45 days

**Concept Used:**

If A is twice as efficient as B, A will take half the time taken by B to finish the same job. Also, time taken by A and B to complete a job together = 1/(1/A's time + 1/B's time)

**Solution:**

⇒ Let the time taken by B to complete the job be x days. Then A's time = x/2.

⇒ From the given, x - x/2 = 45 ⇒ x = 90 days (Time taken by B alone)

⇒ Time taken by A alone = 90/2 = 45 days

⇒ Time taken by A and B together = 1/(1/45 + 1/90) = 30 days

**Therefore, they can finish the job together in 30 days.**

questions.question: Anand covers a distance of 20 km at the speed of 4 km/h and he covers remaining distance at the speed of 5 km/h in 5 hours. What is the average speed (in km/h) of Anand for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First distance = 20 km at 4 km/h

Second distance = 5 km/h for 5 hours = 25 km

**Concept Used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Solution:**

⇒ Total distance = 20 km + 25 km = 45 km

⇒ Total time = 20 km / 4 km/h + 5 hours = 5 hours + 5 hours = 10 hours

⇒ Average speed = 45 km / 10 hours = 4.5 km/h

**Therefore, the average speed of Anand for the whole journey is 4.5 km/h.**

questions.solution: ‘किसी के कहने के बाद कहना’ इस वाक्यांश के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले एक शब्द से रिक्त स्थान (**4**) की पूर्ति किया जा सकता है - **__अनुवाद__** __ • इसलिए अब हम किसी दूसरी सीखी हुई भाषा को बोलते हैं, तो मातृभाषा में मन में जो हम सोचते हैं, वह उसी का अनुवाद__ होता है। • इसलिए इसके बिना हम रह नहीं सकते। यह हमारे दैनिक जीवन के साथ घुली - मिली है। [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • ​अनुवाद - • ​किसी भाषा में कही या लिखी गयी बात का किसी दूसरी भाषा में सार्थक परिवर्तन अनुवाद (Translation) कहलाता है। [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** टिप्पण टिप्पणी लिखने का कार्य। आलेखन किसी संरचना को मूर्त रूप देने के पूर्व जो प्रकल्पना कागज मे उकेरी जाती है, वही आलेखन है। **संक्षेपण** किसी लिखित सामग्री को मूल के लगभग एक-तिहाई भाग में संक्षिप्त रूप में, सहज भाषा और व्यवस्थित रूप में प्रस्तुत करना 'संक्षेपण' कहलाता है। 1ac:T126e, विकल्पों में से उपयुक्त शब्द का चयन कर रिक्तस्थान (**5**) की पूर्ति किया जा सकता है - **__घुली - मिली__** __ • इसलिए इसके बिना हम रह नहीं सकते। यह हमारे दैनिक जीवन के साथ घुली - मिली__ है। • जैसे - दूध में पानी घुला होता है, उसी तरह मातृभाषा में भी हमारी माँ का संस्कार, उसका प्यार और मिठास है। अतः अपनी भाषा सर्वोपरि है। • भाषाओं के अध्ययन में इसी का सबसे ऊँचा स्थान है। यही कारण है कि सभी सभ्य देशों में शिक्षा मातृभाषा के माध्यम से दी जाती है।
